title: I.C. Golak Nath v. State of Punjab

content.caseIdentity: I.C. Golak Nath v. State of Punjab, AIR 1967 SC 1643
content.holding: Overruled Shankari Prasad; held that a constitutional amendment under Article 368 is a "law" under Article 13(2), and Parliament cannot abridge Fundamental Rights. Introduced prospective overruling.
content.relevance: Historic 11-judge bench judgment on Part III inviolability.

archivedReason: Duplicate identity; canonical Golaknath record retained.
